name: The Awa Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Awa Bank, Ltd. provides banking, leasing, and financial services in Japan. It offers savings, foreign currency, and time deposits; home, car, card, home renovation, education, business, and SDG loans; and life insurance, fire insurance, defined contribution pension, testamentary and family trust, educational fund gifts, and safe deposit box. The company also provides business succession and M&A support, start-up support, business matching, recruitment services, and medical and nursing support; and internet banking, electronic money, foreign exchange web services, farm banking services, and money transfers. In addition, it is involved in leasing operations; and credit guarantee business. …
